items.headline: $ETHFI Jumps 14% on Buyback Vote as Market Sells Off
items.summary: $ETHFI rose 14.2% after a buyback vote, bucking a broad crypto selloff that hit 103 of the 125 largest non-stablecoin tokens.

items.headline: $ARC Unveils AI Agent That Builds Onchain Apps From Prompts
items.summary: $ARC launched Arc Studio, an AI coding agent that generates onchain apps and smart contracts from simple text prompts.

items.headline: Robinhood Chain Mainnet Goes Live With Stock Tokens & Lending
items.summary: Robinhood opened its Arbitrum-based L2, adding stock tokens, onchain lending, and agentic AI crypto trading. Big new DeFi use cases for $HOOD's ecosystem.

items.headline: Korean Super-App Toss Pilots Won Stablecoin on $OP Stack
items.summary: South Korean fintech giant Toss will run a won stablecoin pilot on Optimism's $OP Stack, a major real-world adoption signal for the ecosystem.

items.headline: Revolut Starts $EURR Rollout With Bridge as Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opened $EURR to selected customers in three countries, with Bridge reporting just €374 outstanding versus €394.5M of Circle's EURC — huge room to grow.
